subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should xAI video polling and generated-media downloads fail closed behind the shared SSRF guard by default, requiring explicit `request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` for private destinations?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent and security-improving, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for existing private-proxy or private-endpoint setups, so automation should not choose that compatibility boundary on the maintainer's behalf.

options.title: Confirm default-deny boundary
options.body: Keep guarded polling and downloads as the default, require explicit private-network opt-in, refresh the branch, and land after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Preserve legacy reachability
options.body: Pause the PR and redesign the behavior only if existing private-destination video workflows must remain reachable without explicit policy opt-in.

recommendation.title: Confirm default-deny boundary
recommendation.body: Keep guarded polling and downloads as the default, require explicit private-network opt-in, refresh the branch, and land after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history ties this person most directly to the current xAI video request and polling behavior.
